combination_suffix_rule: Repeat the combination_suffix_fields as _2..._N; require combination_size and combination_id when N > 1.

field_state_scoring.present: requires source plus exact non-null numerator/denominator coverage
field_state_scoring.alias_only: requires named alias source plus exact non-null numerator/denominator coverage
field_state_scoring.manifest_only: blocked until a reviewed dataset-level waiver or row projection proves coverage
field_state_scoring.missing: false when the field is applicable
field_state_scoring.not_applicable: excluded from the applicable denominator; never rewritten as missing

separate_var_verdict.name: VAR_ENSEMBL_SPECIES_COMPLETED
separate_var_verdict.pass_condition: Every biological feature has a stable Ensembl ID mapped to the correct species, with explicit provenance.

scoring_precedence: Any proven failure => false. Otherwise any missing/inconclusive required evidence => blocked. Otherwise => true.
proposed_rules: Applicable present/alias fields require 100% non-null coverage; no historical threshold was recovered.
manifest_only evidence blocks rather than passes; no historical waiver policy was recovered.
All member-level checks must pass before a logical_dataset can pass.
